title: Recoveries Standard: Charged-Off Settlement Plan (Hardship Assistance Programs)
content:
A Charged-Off Settlement Plan under the Hardship Assistance Programs resolves a charged-off loan for less than the full balance.

## 1. When a settlement may be offered

A settlement is offered only when the current date is at least the program's minimum days after the loan's charge-off date. The days are counted in calendar days starting the day after the charge-off date; the charge-off date is the one on the company's loan record, and reaching the minimum on the day itself is enough.

| Charge-off date (hypothetical) | Minimum days | First day a settlement may be offered | The day before |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 March | 30 | 31 March | 30 March: not yet |

## 2. Choice of payment — retired clause

The clause under which the borrower chose a single payment at the lump-sum percent or monthly installments at the installment percent is **no longer in force**; the borrower's choice and the price of the settlement follow the current Charged-Off Settlement Plan rules.

## 3. Payments and completion

Settlement payments post to the loan as payments of type "settlement payment". When the settlement amount has been paid in full the plan completes and the loan becomes settled; the forgiven remainder is reported on Form 1099-C when it reaches the program's threshold.

## 4. A missed settlement installment

If a settlement installment is missed past the plan grace period the plan breaks, amounts paid stay credited to the balance, and the full remaining charged-off balance is owed again.

The minimum days since charge-off and the Form 1099-C threshold are given in the program schedules.

superseded_clauses: The borrower chooses a single payment at the lump-sum percent or monthly installments at the installment percent;
